body:
Minor version, 1.14.0. Nothing had shipped by the time phases 1–3 were all
built, so they go out together; T-160 folds into this and closes with it.

Notes must say: an open expense list cannot be left or deleted; a closed one is
a read-only archive; settlements are ordinary expenses and count toward the
total. Release testing should include the upgrade over 1.13.0, not only a clean
install: this is the first release where an existing install runs a migration
from the expense work (server 6 and 7, Android 5->6).
title: Release: expense lists, all three phases
